title: Three bad challenges per point on the subgroup of order n: at least 3n at rates just above 1/4
With leftover points the count is at least 3.12n at agreement k + 6n/25, so any constant in T1Uniform is at least 3.12
Lists give bad challenges: a linear T1Uniform bound forces constant Reed-Solomon lists beyond Johnson in large characteristic
Lean 4 against the pinned ArkLib predicate: the uncovered-point lemma, the R u count, the characteristic-two identity and the (2^m - 1) u count, with two hypotheses the informal statement omitted

Characteristic two, outside T1's field condition: at least (n0 - 1) u bad challenges at the T1 agreement; an independent rediscovery of Theorem 4.7 of Dao, Kominers, Thaler and Zheng (ECCC TR26-237), whose count is superpolynomial
Negative search: no growing Reed-Solomon list at slack 0.2496 in large characteristic up to length 7,681; four or more members force a rank drop linear in the length
Coset family at a fixed gap 1/s on the subgroup of order n: at least C(s - 1, d + 1) bad challenges per point at k = d n/s + 2, so C(delta) grows like 2^(1/delta)
The exponent ledger: DKT's method gives exponents 27 at gap 0.2 and about 2,200 at gap 0.1 at rate 1/4; the 2-adic structure removes only invariant challenges
Krachun, Kazanin and Haboeck at a fixed gap has exponent 0, with a constant that caps soundness below gap 1/16; the lower-bound constants depend on k mod n/s and vanish at the exact k = rho n

No Gold-type mechanism on the subgroup of order n: coset-aligned families are lifts, polynomial fibrations are only x^t, BKR-type families in characteristic 0 are coset swaps; an inverse statement is posed
